question: What is the base engine warranty duration?
reference_answer: 2 years or 2000 hours, whichever occurs first.

question: When does the warranty start for a stationary fire pump drive engine?
reference_answer: On the date of initial start-up, demonstration or eighteen months after the factory ship date, whichever is sooner.

The engine will not stop after the fire pump controller is switched off. What do I check, in order?
reference_answer: With the controller OFF, check whether B+ is being supplied to TB-1 by the fire pump controller. If yes, contact the controller manufacturer or the installing contractor. If no, ask whether the panel is in manual mode: if yes, switch it to AUTO and restart the engine. If no, open the panel and check the manual keyswitch override toggle: if it is set to the right, move it to the left and restart; if not, note the AUTO WAKE and KEY FB LED states and call Cummins.
